questions.question: The LCM and HCF of the two numbers are 450 and 30, if one number is 90, then find the difference between these two numbers.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

Second Number = (450 × 30) ÷ 90 = 150

Difference = 150 − 90 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of the two numbers = 450

HCF of the two numbers = 30

First number = 90

**Formula Used:**

First Number × Second Number = LCM × HCF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01320fd5ece011dbd61964b0452f3e11d44db16e110d872305b5e51fb2d7bd87.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the second number be x.

⇒ 90 × x = 450 × 30

⇒ 90 × x = 13500

⇒ x = 13500 ÷ 90

⇒ x = 150

⇒ Difference = Second number − First number

⇒ Difference = 150 − 90 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Formula

For any two given numbers a and b, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their LCM and HCF: a × b = LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. In such cases, their LCM is simply the product of the two numbers.

LCM and HCF of Fractions

LCM of fractions = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators.
HCF of fractions = HCF of Numerators ÷ LCM of Denominators.
</p

questions.question: The L.C.M. of (2)/(4), (5)/(6), (10)/(8) is:
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

LCM of Fraction = LCM of Numerator/HCF of Denominator

**Calculation:**

​​(2)/(4), (5)/(6), (10)/(8) = (1)/(2), (5)/(6), (5)/(4)

⇒ LCM of (1, 5, 5) = 5

⇒ HCF of (2, 6, 4) = 2

⇒ dfrac{LCM of (1,5,5)}{HCF of (2,4,6)} = 5/2

**∴ The correct answer is 5/2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__** Please note that LCM means the lowest common multiple. LCM is the lowest number which is completely divisible by all given numbers(2/4, 5/6, 10/8). 

In these types of questions, make sure that you reduce the fractions to their lowest forms before you use their formulae, otherwise, you may get the wrong answer.

If we don't reduce the fractions to their lowest forms then LCM is 5 but the LCM of these 3 numbers is 5/2.

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 720. If their Least Common Multiple is 360, then what will be the Highest common Factor of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The product of two numbers = 720

Least Common Multiple = 360

**Concept:**

Product of two numbers always will be the product of their Least Common Multiple and Highest common Factor

**Formula used:**

Product of 2 numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculation:**

720 = 360 × HCF

∴ HCF = 720/360 = 2

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 840 and their HCF is 7 . If one of the numbers is 56 , find the other.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Second Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

Second Number = (7 × 840) ÷ 56 = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF = 7

LCM = 840

First Number = 56

**Formula:**

First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

⇒ Let the second number be x.

⇒ 56 × x = 7 × 840

⇒ x = (7 × 840) ÷ 56

⇒ x = 5880 ÷ 56

⇒ x = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule for Two Numbers

For any two positive integers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b. This rule only applies to exactly two numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators) and LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their HCF is 1. For such numbers, their LCM is simply their product (LCM = a × b).</p

questions.question: The least number of square tiles required to pave the floor of a room with dimensions 15 meters and 12 meters will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

Length of Room = 15 meters

Breadth of room = 12 meters

Concept used:

To find the least number of square tiles we have to find the highest common factor of Length and Breadth

Calculation:

Length of room = 15 meters

Breadth of room = 12 meters

So, H.C.F of 15 and 12 

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 12 = 3 × 2²

Here, only 3 is common

So, H.C.F = 3

Now, Area of 1 tile = 3 × 3

Area of Room = 15 × 12

Number of tiles required = (15 × 12) / (3× 3)

⇒ Number of tiles required = 20

∴ Number of tiles required is 20.

questions.question: The L.C.M. of 5/7, 10/9 and 15/11 will be _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Fractions = 5/7, 10/9 and 15/11

**Formula used:**

LCM of fractions = (LCM of numerators)/(HCF of denominators)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

LCM of fractions = (LCM of 5, 10, 15)/(HCF of 7, 9, 11)

⇒ 30/1 = 30

**∴ LCM of 5/7, 10/9 and 15/11 is 30.**

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 20 times of their HCF and LCM + HCF = 2520. What will be the difference of LCM and HCF ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let HCF = 1 unit ⇒ LCM = 20 units.

Total sum = 20 + 1 = 21 units.

Given, 21 units → 2520 ⇒ 1 unit → 120.

Difference between LCM and HCF = 20 − 1 = 19 units.

Required difference = 19 × 120 = 2280.

**∴ The correct answer is 2280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM = 20 × HCF

LCM + HCF = 2520

 Relationship between LCM and HCF
 
 LCM (20 units)
 
 HCF (1 unit)
 

 Total Sum
 = 21 units
 = 2520
 Difference = 20 units - 1 unit = 19 units

**Calculations:**

Let the HCF of the two numbers be x.

⇒ LCM = 20x

According to the given condition,

⇒ LCM + HCF = 2520

⇒ 20x + x = 2520

⇒ 21x = 2520

⇒ x = 2520 ÷ 21

⇒ x = 120

So, the HCF is 120.

⇒ LCM = 20 × 120 = 2400

Now, finding the difference between LCM and HCF:

⇒ Difference = LCM − HCF

⇒ Difference = 2400 − 120

⇒ Difference = 2280

**∴ The correct answer is 2280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Two Numbers

For any two given numbers, the product of the numbers is strictly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are said to be co-prime if their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 1. The LCM of two co-prime numbers is always equal to their product.

LCM and HCF of Fractions

LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators)
HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators)
</p

questions.question: Five clocks ring simultaneously at 5 pm. They ring at regular intervals of 12 min, 15 min, 20 min, 30 min, and 60 min respectively. The time when all five clocks ring together next is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Five clock ring at = 5 pm

**Concept:**

The least number which is exactly divisible by each of the given numbers is called the least common multiple of those numbers.

**Calculation:**

12 = 2 × 2 × 3

15 = 3 × 5

20 = 2 × 2 × 5

30 = 2 × 3 × 5

60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM of 12, 15, 20, 30 and 60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 = 60 min

All five clocks ring after 60 min or 1 hrs

∴ The next time all five clocks at = 5 : 00 + 1 hr = 6 p.m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd67c9563cdde4a0dfe99b7686282bc07365f691adfb64c907de66aebe4b011.png] 

Let the name of clocks be A, B, C, D and E 

Clock A will ring at **05:00**, 5:12, 05:24, 05:36, 05:48, **06:00**

Clock B will ring at **05:00**, 5:15, 05:30, 05:45, **06:00**

Clock C will ring at **05:00**, 5:20, 05:30, **06:00**

Clock D will ring at **05:00**, 5:30, **06:00**

Clock E will ring at **06:00**

**So, after ringing together at 5 o'clock, the bells will again ring together at 6 o'clock.**

questions.question: There are 28 mango trees, 42 apple trees and 21 orange trees have to be planted in rows such that each row contains the same number of trees of one variety only. The minimum number of rows in which the above trees may be planted is:
questions.solution:
**Given - **

Number of Mango tree = 28

Number of Apple tree = 42

Number of Orange tree = 21

**Solution - **

Let the minimum number of rows be n.

⇒ maximum number of plant in each row = HCF (28, 42, 21) = 7

⇒ minimum row = (28/7) + (42/7) + (21/7) = 4 + 6 + 3 = 13

**∴ minimum number of row = 13.**
